items.text: Japan’s Emperor Akihito formally abdicated last Tuesday, becoming the first Japanese monarch to step down in centuries. His son, Crown Prince Naruhito, took over as the country’s 126th emperor the following day. The former emperor’s title is now Emperor Emeritus – which means former emperor with honours. At the abdication ceremony on Tuesday, Akihito said that he considers himself ‘most fortunate’ to have been able to complete the duties of emperor with a ‘deep sense of trust and respect for the people’. He also wished his son’s era to be ‘a stable and fruitful one’. Japanese Prime Minister, Shinzo Abe, attended the ceremony, and the US President, Donald Trump, will be the first foreign leader to meet with Japan’s new emperor on a scheduled trip on May 25th. Difficult words: abdicate (step down), former (ex-), fruitful (good, productive). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Japan’s Emperor Akihito formally abdicated last Tuesday, and he became the first Japanese emperor to step down in centuries. His son, Crown Prince Naruhito, took over as the country’s 126th emperor. At the abdication ceremony, Akihito said that he was very lucky to be able to serve as the country’s emperor. He also wished his son’s era to be ‘a stable’ and good one. Japanese Prime Minister, Shinzo Abe, attended the ceremony. President Donald Trump will be the first foreign leader to meet with Japan’s new emperor on May 25th. Difficult words: emperor (a king of an empire – a country), abdicate (step down, stop being in a position), attend (be at an event). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Japan does not have kings or queens. It has emperors . Japan’s emperor is Emperor Akihito. He is old. He steps down . He steps down last Tuesday. He does this at an official ceremony . He says that he is lucky to be an emperor. He wishes good luck to his son. His son becomes the new emperor. He is Japan’s 126th emperor. His name is Naruhito. Difficult words: emperor (another name for a king), step down (stop being in a job), ceremony (an important event). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Both presidential and legislative elections took place in Indonesia on the same day, April 17th. Ten days later after the elections, officials reported that over 270 election staff died, mostly from fatigue -related illnesses. CNN reported that around six million election workers were involved in the dual elections – more than 1,800 of them were sick after helping with the elections and counting millions of ballots by hand. One official said that the dual elections, combined with the pressure to deliver results quickly, could have been the reason of the deaths and illnesses. Difficult words: legislative elections (elections of people who go to the parliament), fatigue (being extremely tired), ballot (a piece of paper which say for whom you voted). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Both presidential and legislative elections took place in Indonesia on the same day, April 17th. Ten days later after the elections, officials reported that over 270 election staff died. CNN reports that around six million election staff worked at the elections. More than 1,800 of them got sick after helping with the elections. People say that so many people died and got sick because they were extremely tired. The two elections happened at the same time, and the staff had too much work to do. Difficult words: legislative elections (elections of people who go to the parliament), official noun (a person in a position of power), staff (workers). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Two elections take place in Indonesia. People choose their president in one election. They choose the members of parliament in the second election. Both elections take place on the 17th April. Around six million people work on the elections. Some of them have too much work. They get very tired and ill. Some of them even die. More than 1,800 people get ill. More than 270 people die. Difficult words: elections (when people choose the leaders/bosses/laws), member (a person who is part of a group), parliament (a place where all leaders of a country meet and talk). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The European Parliament gave the green light to copyright reforms with big changes for technology companies. The ‘copyright bill’ is one law that the parliament passed. One part of the law says that Internet sites will have to pay publishers to show their work. This means that a site like Google News would pay news organisations for their stories on its site. Another part of the law makes companies like Facebook or Google responsible if their users make any copyright infringements . Critics say that it will be very difficult and expensive for even powerful technology companies to manage these changes. They worry that this law will stop online creativity or not allow people to say what they think. Difficult words: give the green light (approve of something, allow something to begin), copyright reform (a change to law about copyright – the protection of someone’s ideas so someone else cannot easily copy them), copyright infringement (copying someone else’s ideas without permission or without paying money). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

The European Parliament passed a law for copyright reforms . There are some big changes for technology companies. One part of the law says that Internet sites need to pay other organisations to show their work or writings. This means that a news site needs to pay another news organisation to show its stories on its site. Another part of the law makes companies responsible for their users’ actions. If their users make copyright infringements , the companies get in trouble. Critics say that doing this is difficult for technology companies, and they worry that this will stop online creativity and free speech. Difficult words: copyright reform (a change to law for copyright – the protection of a person’s ideas so someone else cannot easily copy them), copyright infringement (copying a person’s ideas without permission or without paying money), free speech (when you can say what you think). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The European Parliament passes a new law. It is about copyright reforms . It makes big changes for technology companies. The law says that Internet sites need to pay to show another organisation’s work. This means that a news site has to pay to show news from another news organisation. The law also says that Internet companies need to watch their users . If their users break the law , the companies get in trouble. Critics do not like this. They say that this can stop creativity on the Internet. They say that people cannot say what they think after this. Difficult words: copyright reform (a copyright law change – copyright is when you protect a person’s ideas so another person cannot easily copy them), user (a person who uses or goes on a website), break the law (do something which the law says you must not do). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A victims’ rights law firm is accusing almost 8,000 Boy Scout leaders of sexual abuse to almost 12,000 children. The victims’ rights law firm released the names of about 50 of the accused abusers in New Jersey. It is filing lawsuits in New Jersey and in New York. The information comes from a professor who reviewed the Boy Scouts’ ‘ perversion files’ for the last five years. The professor said that the organisation works hard to protect children, and there was no cover-up . The Boy Scouts of America said that it reports all suspected abuse to law enforcement, it has required youth protection trainings, it performs background checks, and it has a database to screen volunteers of inappropriate behaviour. Difficult words: perversion (doing things that are socially or morally unacceptable), cover-up (hide information), screen (find out information about something or someone). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

A professor reviewed the Boy Scouts’ files over concerns of sexual abuse . From that review, a victims’ rights law firm is accusing almost 8,000 Boy Scout leaders of sexual abuse to over 12,000 children. The firm is filing lawsuits in New Jersey and in New York. The Boy Scouts of America said that it wants to protect children. The organisation says that it reports all suspected abuse, it has required trainings, it investigates the people who work for it, and it has a database to record peoples’ behaviour. Difficult words: abuse (doing something bad to a person’s body), victim’s rights law firm (a group of lawyers who want to help victims – people who were hurt), accuse (say that someone did something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Boy Scouts of America is an organisation. It teaches children new skills. However, all is not good in the organisation. Some people are worried that some children are sexually abused . Lawyers are suing the organisation. The lawyers say that almost 8,000 Boy Scout leaders sexually abuse almost 12,000 children. The Boy Scouts of America says that it is trying to protect the children. They say that they check if people do anything wrong. Difficult words: sexually abuse (do bad things to someone’s body), sue (officially say that somebody does something wrong), leader (a boss or a ‘teacher’). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The American government agencies of NASA and FEMA (the Federal Emergency Management Agency) are working together to hold a drill in case an asteroid comes towards the earth. Scientists from across the world are attending a conference this week to talk about objects which threaten the earth and the steps that we can take to stop them. NASA says that an asteroid hitting the earth is not likely, but the exercise will help develop ‘more effective communications with each other and with our governments’. Difficult words: drill (a training), attend (be at an event), threaten (put in danger). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

NASA and FEMA (the Federal Emergency Management Agency) are working together. They are going to have a training of things to do if an asteroid comes towards the earth. Scientists from across the world are attending a conference this week. They are going to talk about objects which can put the earth in danger and about the things the people can do to stop them. NASA says that there is little chance that an asteroid will hit the earth. Difficult words: emergency (a situation when somebody is in danger), attend (be at an event), object (a thing). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Asteroids can hit the earth. NASA says that this can happen. However, there is a very small chance . NASA does want to talk about this. NASA starts working with FEMA. FEMA is another American government agency . The agencies hold a conference. Scientists from all over the world come to the conference. They talk about asteroids. They talk about what people can do to protect Earth. Difficult words: asteroid (a rock which is flying in space), small chance (no change – something is not going to happen vs. high chance – something is going to happen), government agency (the offices of people who do some work for the government – the ‘bosses’ of a country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In the USA, the Federal Aviation Administration (which is a governmental body with powers to regulate all aspects of civil aviation) approved air carrier certification for Alphabet’s drone delivery service. The approval is important to the company and for the industry as a whole. Alphabet is Google’s parent company, which has been testing drone delivery services in Australia where it has carried out over ’70,000 test flights, and more than 3,000 deliveries’. With the FAA’s approval, it says that it will now start testing in southwest Virginia over the next several months. Difficult words: aviation (related to flying), body (an organisation, a big part of something bigger), approve (say that something can happen). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Alphabet is Google’s parent company which also works with drones. It wants to use drones for deliveries , and it tested drones for this in Australia. The company carried out 70,000 test flights, and more than 3,000 deliveries. After such testing, the FAA (a part of the American government, which controls flying in the USA) approved the drones in the USA. Now Alphabet will begin tests in Virginia, an American state. This is a big moment for Alphabet, but also for everybody who wants to use drones. Difficult words: parent company (the company which owns another company), delivery (when you phone somebody to buy something, or buy something on the Internet, somebody or something moves it to you – which is called a delivery), approve (say that something can happen). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

This news is about drones. Drones are very small planes. They can move things. Some companies want to make money with drones. Drones can deliver things. Alphabet is a company. It tests drones in Australia. It does more than 70,000 test flights, and makes more than 3,000 deliveries. The American government says that the company can use the drones in the USA. The company is now starting tests in Virginia (an American state). Difficult words: company (a business), deliver (move to you after you buy it on the Internet, a catalogue or on the phone), government (the leaders/‘bosses’ of a country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There have been more than 1,000 arrests during one and a half-week-long protests organised by a group called Extinction Revolution. The protesters demanded actions to address climate change, blocked the entrance of the London Stock Exchange, and held banners in a London financial district last Thursday. One of the banners read ‘business as usual = death’, meaning that doing nothing can be catastrophic for the planet. The protests and spectacles were disruptive to the city, but the organisation said that it made its point. One activist said that it had become very popular and politicians noticed. The Extinction Revolution wants the government to create a national program which would reduce carbon emission, which contribute to global warming, to zero by 2025. Similar climate protests took place in New York, Berlin, Paris and at the Hague. Difficult words: demand (strongly ask for something), spectacle (a show), disruptive (causing disruption – blocking traffic, changing how normally things go). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In London, there were 1.5-week-long protests organised by a group called Extinction Revolution. The police made more than 1,000 arrests. The protesters demanded actions which would help stop climate change. The activists blamed the London Stock Exchange, and they held banners in a London financial district last Thursday. One of the banners read ‘business as usual = death’, which means that doing nothing can be catastrophic for the planet. The organisation said that it made its point. One activist said that everything was very popular and politicians knew it. The Extinction Revolution wants the British government to create a program. The program would reduce carbon emissions to zero by 2025. Similar climate protests took place in New York, Berlin, Paris and at the Hague. Difficult words: extinction (the dying out of humans/animals/plants), demand (strongly ask for something), district (a part of a city). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There are protests in London. A group called Extinction Revolution organises the protests. The protests are 1.5 weeks long. Police arrest more than 1,000 people. The activists say that their protests are working. They are very popular. Politicians know it. The activists want the politicians to make a plan. The plan is to have zero carbon emissions by 2025. Difficult words: extinction (the dying out of humans/animals/plants), activist (a protester), politician (a ‘leader/boss’ of a country), carbon emissions (the things which get into the air from cars, houses and factories). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

One of the most anticipated movies in recent memory officially hit theatres last Thursday and already had broken records. Preview screenings for Marvel’s saga-ending film ‘Avengers: Endgame’ brought in a record-breaking $60 million, which kicked ‘Star Wars: The Force Awakens’ out of the top spot. Analysts predicted that the blockbuster could make as much as $300 million in its opening weekend, which would break the record for the biggest opening weekend ever. ‘Endgame’s’ predecessor ‘Avengers: Infinity War,’ held that spot, having made nearly $258 million in its first weekend. Fandango, an American company which sells movie tickets said that the film is the biggest pre-seller in movie history. Difficult words: anticipate (when people look forward to seeing something), preview screening (showing the film only to some people so analysts can predict everyone else’s reactions), predict (think and try to guess what is going to happen). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

‘Avengers: Endgame’ is one of the most anticipated films in recent memory. It is the newest ‘Avengers’ film, and it hit theatres last Thursday and already broke some records. Preview screenings for the film brought a record $60 million, which kicked ‘Star Wars: The Force Awakens’ out of the top place. Analysts also said that the film would make more than $300 million in its opening weekend. That would be more than the film’s predecessor ‘Avengers: Infinity War’ – it made nearly $258 million in its first weekend. Difficult words: anticipate (when you look forward to seeing something), preview screening (showing the film only to some people so that analysts can guess others’ reactions), predecessor (a film in the series which comes before the new film). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

‘Avengers: Endgame’ is the newest ‘Avengers’ film. Many people are looking forward to seeing it. People can see it already. They can go to cinemas. The film is making a lot of money. It makes $60 million in preview screenings . That is more than ‘Star Wars: The Force Awakens’. Analysts think that the film can make more than $300 million in its opening weekend. That is more than ‘Avengers: Infinity War’. That movie makes almost $258 million in its first weekend. Difficult words: look forward to something (very excited to see something), preview screening (showing a film only to some people and then analysts can tell how many people are going to see it and like it), analyst (a person who looks at some information and tries to tell what is going to happen). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Political newcomer Volodymyr Zelenskiy won in the Ukrainian presidential elections, garnering 73 per cent of the final vote to Petro Poroshenko’s 24 per cent. Before Zelenskiy entered politics, he was an actor best known for playing the country’s fictional president on a popular TV series. His TV character won the office accidentally after he went on an extremely popular anti-corruption rant . Zelenskiy leveraged his popularity from the show, and he ran a real-life political campaign focused on fighting corruption. Poroshenko’s campaign, on the other hand, was strongly anti-Russian and nationalistic. The new president is not pro-Russian, but Poroshenko argued that he has no experience, so it will be easy for Russia to manipulate him. Russia said that there may be an improvement of relations between Ukraine and Russia, although Putin’s office says that it is still too early to talk about cooperation. Regardless, Ukraine’s parliament is dominated by Poroshenko’s supporters, and elections are not scheduled to happen until October, so Zelenskiy probably cannot do much right away. Difficult words: garner (collect, get), rant (speaking emotionally and critically about something), leverage (use to a maximum). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Ukraine, presidential elections recently happened. The two finalists were Volodymyr Zelenskiy and Petro Poroshenko, the country’s current president. Zelenskiy collected 73 per cent of the final vote and Poroshenko only 24 per cent. Zelenskiy, the winner, is a political newcomer. Before he entered politics, he was an actor best known for playing the country’s fictional president on a popular TV series. His TV character won the office after he went on an extremely popular anti-corruption rant . Zelenskiy used his popularity from the show, and he ran a real-life political campaign with the main focus onfighting corruption. Poroshenko’s campaign, on the other hand, was strongly anti-Russian and nationalistic. The new president is not pro-Russian, but Poroshenko thinks that because he has no experience in politics, it will be easy for Russia to manipulate him. Russia said that things can get better between Ukraine and Russia, but Putin’s office said that it is still too early. Difficult words: election (when people vote to choose their leaders), rant (speaking emotionally and critically about something), focus (interest, the most important thing). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Volodymyr Zelenskiy is a Ukrainian actor. He plays a popular TV character . The character talks about corruption . He becomes the Ukrainian president on the show. The actor Zelenskiy uses this popularity. He talks about corruption in real life. He runs for president in real life. He wins in real life. His opponent is Petro Poroshenko. Zelenskiy gets 73 per cent of votes . Poroshenko only gets 23 per cent. Difficult words: character (a person in a film/a TV series/a book), corruption (when a leader of a country takes money from somebody to do something, or he or she does something which is bad for people), vote (when a person chooses a leader or a law). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

China showed off its new military force at a naval parade, including new nuclear submarines, and the first of its next-generation guided-missile destroyers . This happened last Tuesday. The parade marked the 70th anniversary of the creation of the People’s Liberation Army Navy. China’s President, Xi Jinping, has a goal to turn the country’s navy into a ‘world-class force’. China has been developing stealth jets and aircraft carriers, as well – the country’s first-ever domestically built aircraft carrier is currently undergoing sea trials and was not at the military parade. Newsy is the original news provider which reports are modified into three levels of difficulty. As Newsy previously reported, one of the reasons that countries throw military parades is to showcase their military power without blowing anything up. Difficult words: guided-missile destroyers (a destroyer – a military ship which can launch guided missiles), stealth jet (a military plane which cannot be easily ‘seen’ by radar), domestically (in China only). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

China showed off its new military force at a naval parade. People could see new nuclear submarines, and they could see a new generation of destroyers last Tuesday. The parade celebrated the Chinese navy which the country created 70 years ago. China’s President Xi Jinping has a goal to turn the country’s navy into a ‘world-class force’. China is also working on new military planes and aircraft carriers (a ship which can carry planes). A new aircraft carrier, which people built completely in China, was not at the parade because people were testing it at sea. Difficult words: military (related to fighting, such as the army), naval (of the navy – the part of the military which fights at sea), destroyer (a type of military ship). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

The Chinese navy is 70 years old. There is a parade . China shows off its newest submarines and ships. China’s President Xi Jinping wants China to have a powerful navy. China creates new planes, too. China has a new ship. It can carry a plane. It is not at the parade. People test it at sea. Difficult words: navy (the soldiers and machines which fight at sea), parade (a celebration, a show), create (make, build). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

​Nearly 90 per cent of Egyptian voters approved of granting President Abdel-Fattah el-Sissi more parliamentary power. The new amendments extend Egyptian presidents’ terms from four to six years, and they allow for a maximum of two terms. However, an article specific to El-Sissi extends his current four-year term to six, and it allows him to run again in 2024, meaning that he could stay in office until 2030. Sissi thanked the Egyptian people in a tweet on Tuesday, saying that the vote would be written down in Egyptian historical record. All this comes as a surprise because in 2017, Sissi said that he would respect Egypt’s constitution, and he would not seek a third term. Last year, most voters re-elected him, which was not too surprising, as several rivals were either in jail or forced to quit. Difficult words: approve (say ‘yes’), amendment (a new law based on a previous law), article (a specific text in a law). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Egypt’s government gave the Egyptian President Abdel-Fattah el-Sissi more parliamentary power. Nearly 90 per cent of Egyptian voters approved it. Now, Egyptian presidents can be presidents for two terms , and each term is six years long instead of four years long. El-Sissi, however, can run for a third term – he can run for president in 2024 for the third time and be president until 2030. Sissi thanked the Egyptian people in a tweet on Tuesday. All of this comes as a surprise because in 2017, Sissi said that he would not run for a third time. Last year, most voters re-elected him. That was not surprising because some of his opponents were put in jail or were forced to quit the race . Difficult words: approve (say ‘yes’), term (the duration of time when somebody is president), several (some), race (talking to people so that they choose them as their president). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People are presidents for terms . In Egypt, one term is four years. The Egyptian people change this. The people vote . They change the Egyptian law . Now, one Egyptian presidential term is six years long. One person can be president for two terms. Abdel-Fattah el-Sissi is the Egyptian President now. He is in his second term. For him, there are special new laws. He can be president for a third term. People can vote for him in 2024. He can be president until 2030. Difficult words: term (the length of time when somebody is president), vote (say ‘yes’ or ‘no’ to a new law), law (a document which says what people can and must not do). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

On Sunday morning, at least eight explosions in Sri Lanka killed more than 300 people and injured 500. Both locals and foreigners fell victim to the bombings which mark the country’s worst violence since the end of the Sri Lankan Civil War in 2009. Sri Lankan officials previously accused a local Islamist militant group, but now people believe that multiple organisations are behind the deadly bombings. ISIS claimed responsibility for the bombings via its Amaq news agency, but it did not provide any evidence . Sri Lanka’s defence minister said that the explosions might have been in retaliation for the shootings at two mosques in New Zealand last month. According to the Associated Press, the Sri Lankan security agencies had warning that a local group was planning a suicide attack, but we do not yet know what steps they took to prevent the attacks. Difficult words: accuse (say that somebody did something wrong), evidence (proof, something which shows that something is true), retaliation (revenge). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

On Sunday morning, there were at least eight explosions in Sri Lanka. More than 300 people died and 500 people were injured. This was the worst act of violence since the end of the Sri Lankan Civil War in 2009. People first thought that a Sri Lankan Islamist militant group carried out the attacks, but now people believe that more organisations did it. ISIS said that it carried out the attacks, but it did not give any proof . One Sri Lankan politician thinks that this was revenge for the shootings at two mosques in New Zealand last month. Some media also says that it is possible that police knew about these planned attacks. Difficult words: violence (attacking/killing people), militant (aggressive, a group which fights), proof (something which shows that something is true). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

There is a terrorist attack in Sri Lanka on Sunday. Eight or more bombs explode. More than 300 people die. Five hundred people are injured . ISIS says that this is its terror attack. However, it does not have proof . People think that more terrorist organisations do this attack. One man says that this can be revenge for the terrorist attack in New Zealand last month. Difficult words: injured (have problems with the body), proof (something which shows that something is true), revenge (an attack which you do because you are angry that somebody hurts you). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

An earthquake and a tsunami struck Japan’s Fukushima nuclear power plant in 2011, which led to a massive hydrogen explosion causing the fuel rods to overheat and melt. People expect that the clean-up plan will take up to 40 years to complete, and workers started removing fuel rods from one of the three melted reactors into a protective cask on Monday, April 15th. The workers are using a remotely -operated crane from a control room hundreds of metres away. In total, there are about 1,560 fuel rods near the three melted reactors that need to be moved. Difficult words: fuel rod (a long piece of fuel – energy), cask (a large container/tank/barrel), remotely (from afar – some distance). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

An earthquake and a tsunami struck Japan’s Fukushima nuclear power plant in 2011. This led to a big explosion. Many fuel rods got too hot and they melted . People are cleaning up at the power plant, and it will take them up to 40 years. Workers recently started moving one group of fuel rods into a protective container. The workers are not doing this in person – they are in a control room hundreds of metres away. They are using a crane which they control from the room. In total, they have to move about 1,560 fuel rods. Difficult words: fuel rod (a long piece of fuel – energy), melt (become soft and more like water), crane (a big, tall machine for moving heavy things). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

A nuclear power plan is in Fukushima, Japan. An earthquake and a tsunami hit in 2011. There is a big explosion. Many fuel rods are melted . They are dangerous. They must go into special boxes. People are moving them. There are about 1,560 fuel rods which they must move. This can take up to 40 years. Difficult words: earthquake (when the ground moves), fuel rod (a long piece of fuel – energy), melted (too soft and too much like water). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Late Microsoft co-founder Paul Allen founded Stratolaunch, a company which successfully tested the largest plane by wingspan on Saturday, April 14th. It weighs 227 metric tons, has six engines, is 61-metres-long and has a wingspan longer than a football field. It is designed to carry a rocket loaded with a satellite 7,620 metres into the air before shooting the rocket into space. Stratolaunch says the launching satellites like this is more cost-effective, as planes require less fuel than traditional rockets, cheaper infrastructure and equipment, and they are better equipped to fend off weather delays. Difficult words: late (no longer alive), fend off (deal with, ignore). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Stratolaunch is a company which successfully tested a huge plane on Saturday, April 14th. It is the world’s largest plane by wingspan – it is wider than a football field. It weighs 227 metric tons, is 61-metres-long, and has six engines. It is designed to carry a rocket loaded with a satellite to 7,620 metres in the air. From there, the rocket shoots to space. Stratolaunch says that launching satellites like this is more cost-effective . Planes also deal better with bad weather. Difficult words: huge (very big), launch (send to space), more cost-effective (cheaper). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Stratolaunch is a company. It makes the biggest plane in the world. It is 227 metric tons heavy. It is 61 metres long. It has six engines . It is so big so it can carry a rocket. The rocket has a satellite inside. The plane flies the rocket 7,620 metres in the air. From there, the rocket flies to space . Stratolaunch says that launching satellites like this is cheaper than with normal rockets. Difficult words: engine (the part of a plane which makes the plane move), space (the area outside our planet), launching (sending them to space). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Cyclone Idai hit southern Africa over a month ago, yet the death toll from the storm continues to grow. Officials say that more than 1,000 people have been reported dead in Mozambique, Zimbabwe and Malawi in the aftermath . Thousands of others were injured and millions more affected. Damage assessments are still being conducted in all three countries, but the recovery costs could add up to more than $2 billion. There is also big concern over diseases in the flooded areas. The World Health Organization announced a vaccination campaign to combat a cholera outbreak in Mozambique. Difficult words: death toll (the number of dead people), aftermath (the after-effects of a big event), assessment (a rating, judging something). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

Cyclone Idai hit southern Africa more than a month ago, but people are still dying because of it. They say that more than 1,000 people died in Mozambique, Zimbabwe and Malawi in the storm’s aftermath . Thousands of others were injured, and millions more were affected . People are still not sure how much damage was done, but fixing the damage could cost more than $2 billion. People are also worried about diseases. The World Health Organization said that it is going to vaccinate people against cholera. Difficult words: aftermath (the after-effects of something bad), affect (have a bad effect on somebody or something), damage (breaking something). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Idai is a tropical storm. It hits southern Africa a month ago . It affects millions of people. Thousands of people are injured . Many things are destroyed. It can cost more than $2 billion. The tropical storm is gone. However, people are still dying. They get sick. The World Health Organization plans to help against cholera. Difficult words: ago (before), affect (have a bad effect on somebody or something), to be injured (have problems with the body). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In France, the Notre Dame Cathedral caught on fire earlier this week from an accident, according to investigations. The inferno came down the Cathedral’s spire and burned through the ceiling. However, all is not lost, as the building’s structure and the two front towers still stand. A French official said that 15 or 30 more minutes of the fire could have changed all of this. An official directed firefighters to save much of the smaller and important pieces of art, including Christ’s crown and Saint Louis’ tunic . Those pieces of art are now in the Louvre. People will remove the larger pieces of art when the building is more stable. The art has smoke damage, but people can repair and restore the works. Difficult words: inferno (a large fire), spire (a twisted tower that is usually on a church), tunic (a simple, long white ‘shirt’). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In France, a fire burned down part of the Notre Dame Cathedral. It came down the Cathedral’s spire and burned through the ceiling. The fire started by accident. The building’s structure and the two towers in the front still stand. A French official said that we are lucky that there were not 15 or 30 more minutes of the fire. An official directed firefighters to save much of the smaller and important pieces of art. People will take out the larger pieces of art when the building is more stable. The art has smoke damage, but people can repair the works. Difficult words: spire (a special tower that is usually on a church), structure (the overall shape and design of a building; the ‘skeleton’ of a building), official (someone who works for a government organisation). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In France, a fire happens at the Notre Dame Cathedral. The fire is an accident. It starts up by a tower. It comes down through the ceiling. Firefighters save a lot of the small works of art. An official tells them what works are important. Even though there is a fire, the building does not fall. Its structure still stands. Its two towers in the front still stand. A French official says that people are lucky. People can see if the building is stable . Then they can save the bigger works of art. They can fix the art. Difficult words: official (someone who works for an important organisation of a country), structure (the ‘body’ of a building), stable (stay standing without falling over). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In February, Israeli organisation SpaceIL sent a spacecraft named Beresheet to the moon on a SpaceX rocket. It cost $100 million for the project, which was a fraction of NASA’s billions of dollars for its budget to go to the moon. The spacecraft successfully orbited the moon, but it could not successfully land. As the spacecraft descended to the moon, its main engine cut out . The team controlling the spacecraft started the engine again, but then they could not communicate with it. Israel’s Prime Minister said that ‘if at first you don’t succeed, you try again’. Only the USA, China, and the former Soviet Union have successfully landed spacecraft on the moon. Difficult words: orbit (go around something in a circular shape), descend (go down), cut out (turn off suddenly). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In February, an Israeli organisation sent a spacecraft to the moon. It cost $100 million for the project, which was much less than NASA’s billions of dollars to go to the moon. The spacecraft successfully orbited the moon, but it did not successfully land. As the spacecraft came down to the moon, its main engine suddenly turned off. The people who controlled the spacecraft started the engine again, but then they could not control it. Israel’s Prime Minister said that ‘if at first you don’t succeed, you try again’. Difficult words: spacecraft (a vehicle/machine which works in space), orbit (go around), engine (a part of a machine which moves it). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

In February, an Israeli organisation sends a spacecraft to the moon. It costs $100 million. This is not very much. NASA spends billions of dollars to go to the moon. The Israeli spacecraft flies around the moon. It does this well. It tries to land . This does not go well. Its engine turns off. The people who control the spacecraft try to help. They turn the engine on. They cannot get the spacecraft to go down. Israel’s Prime Minister talks about this. He says that if something does not go well first, you try again. Difficult words: spacecraft (a machine which works in space – outside our planet), land (go to the ground and stop moving), engine (a part of a machine which moves it). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is possibly going to be re-elected after this week’s votes. In Israel, people vote for political parties instead of particular candidates. There are two main political parties: Netanyahu’s party and his rival’s party. There are also small third parties that won seats in Israel’s parliament, and some of these smaller parties support Netanyahu. The new people in parliament may help Netanyahu weather the suspicions of corruption. Strong support from the parliament will lessen the consequences if people find him guilty. In the USA, President Trump welcomed Netanyahu’s victory, and he said that peace is more likely between Israel and Palestine with Netanyahu as leader. Difficult words: seat (a spot, a place), weather (deal with), consequences (the effects). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

In Israel, people voted. The results are that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu is possibly going to be prime minister again. In Israel, people vote for political parties instead of certain people. There are two main political parties, and there are small third parties. Some people voted for many small parties to join the parliament, and some of these parties support Netanyahu. People are accusing Netanyahu of corruption and the new people in parliament may help him. President Trump said that there is a higher chance of peace between Israel and Palestine when Netanyahu is the leader. Difficult words: political party (a group of people that represent a larger group of people in a country and they help run the government), accuse (say that somebody did something wrong), corruption (when you do illegal things as a leader). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People in Israel vote . The Israeli Prime Minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, is probably going to be leader again. In Israel, people vote for political parties . They do not vote for specific people. There are two big political parties. There are some smaller parties, too. Some people vote for the small parties. They get into the parliament. Some of these parties like Netanyahu. This helps him. Some people say that he does bad things as a leader. The new party can help him. President Trump talks about Netanyahu. He says there can be peace between Israel and Palestine if Netanyahu is the leader. Difficult words: vote (choose a party or a leader/boss of a country), going to be (in the future), political party (a group of people that work together to be the leaders of a country), peace (not war). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People found a 5-metre and 64-kilogram female python in the Big Cypress National Preserve in southern Florida. Usually, pythons are between two to three metres long there. People found this python by putting a radio transmitter on a male python to find the female pythons. This helps people find the snakes and learn how they live in the preserve. The type of snake comes from Southeast Asia, but it lives in Florida because of a few reasons. Pet owners release this type of snake when they get too big, or people release them during hurricanes. Pythons are an invasive species for the native animals of Florida, and they do not have a predator to lower their numbers. People try to remove as many as they can. Difficult words: python (a big snake which kills animals with its big body, not by biting them), preserve (a place where animals are protected), invasive species (a type of animal or plant that comes from another place and invades a new place – there starts to be too many of them). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

People found a 5-metre and 64-kilogram female python in a preserve in southern Florida. Pythons are usually between two to three metres long there. The type of snake comes from Southeast Asia, but it lives in Florida. Sometimes pet owners let the snakes go when they get too big. Sometimes people let them go during hurricanes. Pythons are an invasive species in Florida because there is no predator which would hunt them. People try to remove as many pythons as they can. Difficult words: python (a big snake which kills animals with its big body, not by biting them), preserve (a place where animals are protected), invasive species (a type of animal or plant that comes from another place and takes over a new place), predator (an animal that eats another animal). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

People find a big snake in a preserve in southern Florida. It is 5 metres long and 64 kilograms heavy. It is a female python . Pythons are not normally that big there. They are usually only two to three metres long. The python comes from Southeast Asia. It lives in Florida because of people. Sometimes people get the snake as a pet. If the snakes get too big, people let them go into the wild. The python is an invasive species for Florida. There is no animal that eats it. People try to take many pythons out of the wild there. Difficult words: preserve (a protected place for wild plants and animals), female (‘woman’), python (a big snake which kills animals with its big body, not by biting them), invasive species (an animal or plant that comes from somewhere else and takes over a new place to live). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

Heavy rainfall, which started in mid-March, led to non-stop flooding across Iran, destroying nearly 2,000 cities and villages. The rain displaced thousands of people and killed at least 70. An Iranian news agency said that some 140 rivers burst their banks. People reported hundreds of landslides, and hundreds of millions of dollars worth of damage to water and farming infrastructure . The Iranian Red Crescent Society said the ‘volunteers and staff evacuated hundreds of people to safety’ and it was handing out items like tents, blankets and health kits to thousands. However, because of US sanctions on Iran, help from the IFRC (International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies) has not been received. The aid network said that it sent Iran $500,000 but the speaker of Iran’s Parliament said that they didn’t get a dollar because of the American sanctions. Difficult words: displace (the people had to move because of danger), infrastructure (pipes, canals, bridges, or roads), sanctions (blocking a country). You can watch the video news lower on this page.

It started raining heavily in Iran in March. The rain caused flooding and destroyed almost 2,000 cities and villages. Thousands of people had to move, and at least 70 people died. Around 140 rivers burst their banks , there were landslides, and many things were damaged. It will cost hundreds of millions of dollars to repair everything. The Iranian Red Crescent is helping people by evacuating them and giving them tents, blankets and medicine. The IFRC (an international organisation which helps people) said that it sent Iran $500,000, but Iran says that it never got the money. The speaker of Iran’s Parliament said that it did not get a dollar because of American sanctions on Iran. Difficult words: flooding (big water), burst a bank (there was too much water in the river, so the water got over the banks – the side of the river where the water normally stops), sanctions (blocking a country). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.

It rains a lot in Iran. The rain starts in March. There is too much water. Many parts of Iran are flooded . People are in danger. Thousands of them must leave. Seventy people die. The water destroys almost 2,000 cities and villages. The Red Crescent is an organisation in Iran. It helps the people. It helps them move. It gives them tents and blankets . The IFRC is another organisation. It helps people around the world. It sends Iran $500,000. However, Iran says it does not have the money. Iran says that this is because the USA is blocking Iran. Difficult words: flooded (under water), tent (a little ‘house’ from cloth, which protects you from rain and wind), blanket (a thing which you put on your body to stay warm in bed). You can watch the original video in the Level 3 section.
